resources.string: Connect this device and your computer to the same Wi-Fi network. Start transfer, open the address in your computer browser, and select several books. Keep this screen open. Transfer stops when you leave this screen or put the app in the background.

Uses local HTTP on your Wi-Fi network. Share the temporary address only with people you trust. Supports EPUB, FB2, TXT, Markdown, PDF, MOBI and AZW3. Each session accepts up to 20 books, 128 MiB per book and 512 MiB in total. Files import one at a time; existing identical books are reused.
Open this address in your browser
Books imported or already in library: %1$d
Transfer stopped. Start again to get a new address.

Monday to Sunday, one column per week. Darker squares mean more reading: under 15, 30, 60 minutes, then 60 minutes or more. Tap a day for its reading time. Streaks use all recorded days; a current streak may end yesterday.
Online speech is selected. Configure its voice below; the system voice selector applies to system speech.

Read Aloud sends the current text and at most one chunk ahead to the configured speech endpoint. Choose a trusted OpenAI-compatible HTTPS endpoint or Azure Speech with its regional endpoint, voice and language. The API key stays encrypted on this device. Saving does not send a request. OpenAI speed is limited to 0.25–4× and Azure to 0.5–2×; changes apply after already buffered audio. Pause cancels pending requests and resumes from the current chunk boundary. If online speech fails, playback continues from the current chunk using an installed offline system voice when the engine is ready. Otherwise playback reports an error. Your saved online preference is kept for the next Play.
Endpoint: https://<region>.tts.speech.microsoft.com/cognitiveservices/v1. Enter an Azure subscription key and voice name (e.g. en-US-JennyNeural). No speech model is required.
Online speech failed. Continuing with an offline system voice for this playback.
System speech is not ready or no installed offline voice is available. Install a system voice and try Play again.
The system voice could not speak. Check the installed system speech voice and try Play again.
